title: Scalable stochastic modeling of non-Gaussian spatio-temporal fields via autoregressive Gaussian processes: data and code
description: Data and code accompanying the paper "Scalable stochastic modeling of non-Gaussian spatio-temporal fields via autoregressive Gaussian processes." This release contains the scalable spatio-temporal autoregressive Gaussian process method, demonstrated on precipitation data from the CESM Large Ensemble Project. See README.md for installation and usage.
